# Grouped picture outer-shadow controls

Original OOXML controls generated by tools/group_picture_shadow_fixture.py
from this project's own grouped-picture scaffold and four-color PNG. No
corpus artwork, fonts or third-party renderer is bundled. The reference application
exported the 14-page native.pdf; the independent recorder binds its sample
colors and picture/shadow bounds to source/PDF hashes.

Cases cover no shadow, rectangular and elliptical pictures, outlines, blur,
texture alpha, crop outsets, picture rotation, horizontal flip, fixed and
rotating shadow directions, ancestor group rotation, backing fill and a hard
diagonal shadow. Existing nested nonuniform group transforms remain in every
case. Offsets and blur stay physical under those coordinate transforms.

The recorder selects native samples whose 2pt neighborhood avoids sharp
texture/outline boundaries. The small 40px PNG exposes different interpolation
filters in the reference application and Canvas; exact edge colors are not certified. The browser
checks 26,933 remaining RGB samples with a six-level tolerance and independently
checks all painted image/shadow bounds within 1pt. Those checks repeat after
insertion, undo and edited export/reopen, with unchanged picture XML and
unrelated OPC parts. Scaled, skewed and obscured grouped picture shadows remain
unsupported and must not be silently discarded.

ECMA-376 Part 1 section 20.1.8.45 (outerShdw) and CT_OuterShadowEffect define
the source effect. The picture's containing scene owns the effect; the nested
reader resolves only its texture. The effect composites texture, backing fill
and outline together, preserving source declarations in the retained drawing.
